study type: Retrospective observational study using administrative data
exposure: Patient access equity (socioeconomic status and region)
outcome: Utilization of five common procedures (including C-section and vaginal delivery)
cohort: The study analyzed Philippine social health insurance data from patients admitted to 1,295 hospitals in 2019 and 2020.
finding: Hospital admissions for 12 high-burden diseases declined by 54% in 2020 compared to 2019, while overall procedures increased by 13%, with significant declines for non-urgent procedures and respiratory diseases, and disproportionate impacts on the poorest and southern regions.
mod_finding: C-section utilization declined by 5% and vaginal delivery utilization declined by 18% in 2020 compared to 2019.
